method: Primary-source documentation/text review; original v1 still review plus v1.1 direct inspection of two Linear UI images and one BUCK/IBM still. Full external films and restricted social feeds remain unreviewed.

sources.scope_reviewed: Skill format, folder locations, progressive loading, optional host metadata.
sources.observation: Official documentation reviewed; actual authenticated host invocation remains a user smoke test.

sources.scope_reviewed: Skill discovery, invocation and context behavior.
sources.observation: Shared content can be installed under Claude skills; host extensions are not assumed portable.

sources.scope_reviewed: Name, description and directory specification.
sources.observation: Manifests follow the documented base format; executable tests validate our authored subset.

sources.scope_reviewed: Subscription login versus API-key authentication.
sources.observation: The pack never reads or exports credentials and never changes authentication.

sources.scope_reviewed: Authentication options.
sources.observation: Check actual host status. Installing a skill does not change quota or guarantee subscription authentication.

sources.scope_reviewed: Host permission controls.
sources.observation: Skill text is not permission enforcement. Keep consequential operations approval-gated.

sources.scope_reviewed: Project description and credits; embedded film inaccessible.
sources.observation: Useful production reference to inspect in an enabled browser. No frame timing, transitions, playback or audio claimed.

sources.scope_reviewed: Project description/metadata; embedded film inaccessible.
sources.observation: Case page reviewed, not the full animation.

sources.scope_reviewed: Reel page and credits only.
sources.observation: Do not treat a reel page as watched footage.

sources.scope_reviewed: Studio-authored case description.
sources.observation: The studio connects material choices and controlled geometry to a financial brand. Transfer the relationship between meaning and materials, not its identity. Full motion/audio unverified.

sources.scope_reviewed: One video thumbnail, not a played sequence.
sources.observation: Observed repeated rails/cylinders, warm wood and metal/glass surfaces, controlled perspective and limited highlights. One poster cannot establish motion quality.

sources.scope_reviewed: Work index only.
sources.observation: Discovery reference only; individual films were not watched.

sources.scope_reviewed: Primary interview with brand motion practitioners.
sources.observation: The discussion connects sequencing, easing, holds, sound and transitions to meaning, and encourages references beyond other motion work. Our timing defaults remain original heuristics, not measurements of Figma videos.

sources.scope_reviewed: Brand Studio case and poster-system discussion; requested image URLs failed.
sources.observation: The case describes a limited visual vocabulary varied across static, motion and physical surfaces. Design and motion informed each other. Transfer system coherence and purposeful variation, not the glyphs, textures or brand marks.

sources.scope_reviewed: Official campaign design explanation.
sources.observation: The account relates personal listening stories to a campaign-wide identity combining analog/digital material cues. This is campaign rationale, not independent engagement evidence or a feed audit.

sources.scope_reviewed: Campaign hub and content architecture.
sources.observation: A discovery reference for personal stories and reusable campaign formats; do not invent product statistics to imitate Wrapped.

sources.scope_reviewed: One campaign club artwork.
sources.observation: Observed a single centered badge, dimensional edge/material treatment, and a recognizable silhouette. It is a campaign illustration, not an audited social post; do not copy this character or badge.

sources.scope_reviewed: Editorial index only.
sources.observation: Useful for discovering product explanations and customer/editorial stories. Individual feed performance not inspected.

sources.scope_reviewed: Editorial index.

sources.scope_reviewed: Application verification standard overview.
sources.observation: Select requirements appropriate to the application; a checklist does not certify security.

sources.scope_reviewed: Tenant isolation guidance.
sources.observation: Review tenant boundaries across data, caches, jobs and files, not only visible navigation.

sources.scope_reviewed: Optional browser setup documentation.
sources.observation: Browser dependency is optional and installed explicitly. Local exports were tested with Playwright 1.57.0.

sources.scope_reviewed: Official optional video skills.
sources.observation: Optional richer workflow, not a bundled or mandatory dependency.

sources.scope_reviewed: License terms link.
sources.observation: Check current conditions for your use; do not assume every dependency has this package’s MIT license.

sources.scope_reviewed: Official release and commit identity.
sources.observation: CI pins a reviewed release commit; no claim this is the latest or free from vulnerabilities.

sources.scope_reviewed: Official release and commit identity.
sources.observation: CI pins a reviewed release commit; update deliberately after compatibility/security review.

sources.scope_reviewed: Actual application screenshot, not only its page text.
sources.observation: Thin separators, clear navigation/context hierarchy, restrained row density and selective emphasis. These are transferable observations, not a copied layout.

sources.scope_reviewed: Comparison still showing multiple application states.
sources.observation: Consistency of navigation, panel relationships and density across views matters beyond a single hero screenshot.

sources.scope_reviewed: One sculptural motion-project still, not a played film.
sources.observation: Controlled white surfaces, geometric depth and concentrated color contrast. No timing, soundtrack or sequence conclusion is drawn.

sources.scope_reviewed: Motion principles, purpose and relationship to behavior.
sources.observation: Motion should clarify interaction/state; this is guidance, not evidence of a viewed external campaign.

sources.scope_reviewed: Primary account of product UI redesign.
sources.observation: Task hierarchy, density and consistency informed a closer actual screenshot inspection; not an exhaustive live-product audit.
